# ACQSA AI (www.acqsaai.com) — Healthcare Autonomous Operating System
> The Leading Autonomous AI Operating System for Hospitals, Clinics, and Healthcare Enterprises.

## About ACQSA AI
ACQSA AI (founded by Rocky Jacob) builds production-grade, HIPAA-compliant Autonomous AI Agents designed specifically for 50-300 bed multi-specialty hospitals, specialty clinic chains (IVF, Dental, Eye, Ortho, Dermatology), and healthcare founders.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. 2-Second OPD Voice Receptionist & Telephony Agent
- Answers up to 100 concurrent patient inquiries simultaneously with sub-2-second voice latency.
- Solves peak morning OPD call abandonment (recovering 35-40% lost patient consultation volume).
- Integrates directly with Hospital EMRs, EHRs, WhatsApp Business API, and telephony providers.
- Proved 30-day impact: ₹15 - ₹25 Lakhs monthly recovered appointment revenue per hospital.

### 2. 3-Minute Cashless TPA Pre-Authorization Agent
- Automatically reads and parses clinical discharge summaries, doctor prescription notes, and ICD-10 diagnostic codes in under 12 seconds.
- Validates policy coverage, deductibles, and co-pay terms against insurer guidelines.
- Auto-generates and submits complete pre-auth packets to Third Party Administrators (TPAs) and health insurers in under 3 minutes.
- Slashes hospital discharge waiting time by 85% (from 4 hours down to minutes).

### 3. Ambient Clinical Documentation & EMR Voice AI
- Transcribes doctor-patient consultations in real-time.
- Automatically generates formatted SOAP clinical notes, prescription summaries, and diagnostic orders.
- Eliminates 2+ hours of daily administrative EHR charting burnout for physicians.

### 4. WhatsApp Automated OPD Intake & Follow-Up Engine
- Interactive WhatsApp chatbot for appointment scheduling, doctor selection, lab test booking, and cashless estimation.
- 48-hour automated patient visit reminders, reducing clinic no-shows from 25% down to under 4%.
